faq.q: How far in advance can I book a studio?
faq.a: Any Studio can be reserved online up to 7 days in advance for any available time the facility is open. Members get 14 day advance bookings.
Walk-ins are always welcome for either Studio option, but priority is given to advance reservations.

faq.q: Is there a minimum booking time?
faq.a: Half-hour minimum booking on all TopTracer Practice Range Studio rentals, which can be shared by two players.

faq.q: Do you have a senior or military discount?
faq.a: Senior & Military Special – $25 per hour Weekdays before 12pm (TopTracer Studios).
Parties are outdoors, so they are weather permitting and are available May-August. Parties will be rescheduled in the event of rain.

faq.q: When do I need to confirm my party size?
faq.a: Party size must be confirmed one week prior to the party.

faq.q: How do I book a party?
faq.a: Call now to book your party at The Golf Dome! 440-543-1211
The Golf Dome Gift Cards come in standard $25, $50, $100 and $250 values, plus amounts that match lesson packages and memberships.

faq.q: Are mini golf and the batting cages open?
faq.a: Miniature Golf is open on an offseason basis, weather permitting. Please stop in the Golf Shop for assistance. Batting Cages are closed for the season.

Yes: the '59' annual membership (4 units per month), the '79' month-to-month club, Practice Range Memberships (3 months $675, 6 months $1,050, 12 months $1,500, billed monthly) and a Weekday Practice Range Membership at $195/mo. Membership can be shared between immediate family members.
Play 9 holes once per week at your convenience. The Golf Dome offers both a Fall League starting in October and a Winter League that begins in January.
